facts.fact: Douglas=GlobalVill Austin Trust and Safety 助理经理、44 岁、podcast 人；最爱 Third Eye Blind 首专
facts.anchor: There aren’t that many full CDs that Douglas, assistant manager on the Trust and Safety team at GlobalVill’s Austin campus, still listens to on the regular.

facts.fact: 那张 CD 从高一就有、几乎没划痕（track 8 Burning Man 第二段副歌会跳）
facts.anchor: His CD copy, the same one he’s had since freshman year of high school, is probably his most prized possession.

facts.fact: 他把专辑介绍给每任女友（关系持续两到四个月）
facts.anchor: He’s introduced every ex-girlfriend he’s ever had to the album over the years

facts.fact: 今晚七十五度微风——「Third Eye Blind weather」
facts.anchor: But now, finally, the temperature’s perfect—a breezy seventy-five.

facts.fact: 完美摇滚专辑论：无 filler、14 首 bangers、sequencing/arc/theme；Stephan Jenkins 反复写 burn
facts.anchor: What makes a rock album a perfect rock album? No filler, for one. Fourteen bangers, one after another.

facts.fact: 九点上班、经理专属停车位、上司 Sandra（白班）记他登录时间
facts.anchor: he’s got a nine p.m. start time, and he knows his bitch of a manager Sandra (who gets to work the day shift) keeps track of when he logs in to his admin panel each night.

facts.fact: track 5 Graduate=毕业回忆：大学最后两周兄弟会无尽 kegger、人生唯一一次一天两次性
facts.anchor: He’ll always associate that one, naturally, with graduating: those last two weeks of college when he and his best friends transformed their off-campus frat house into an endless kegger.

facts.fact: 车到 HQ 门口见 Bethany 站在黑车旁、两个同伙；白鬼妆 goth 用枪指挡风玻璃喊 Get out of the car
被拖下车跪地求饶；认出是 JulesPublicAccessAfterworld（Tic Tacs 假自杀那家伙）
facts.anchor: It’s that freak from Bethany’s queue, the one Bethany was obsessed with, who chugged all those Tic Tacs to fake a suicide
